skillSays: It is a read-only filter, not a decorator: expect to reject most motion ideas and keep only a few.
Every candidate must pass four gates in order: how often users see it, which named purpose it serves, whether it fits the speed budget, and whether motion helps or hurts function.
High-frequency and keyboard-initiated actions get no animation; delight is allowed only for rare, first-time moments.
Each suggestion carries exact values from a shared vocabulary (ease-out, ease-in-out and ease-drawer curves) and only animates transform and opacity.
Prefer CSS transitions over keyframes so rapid re-triggers retarget smoothly; gate hover effects to hover-capable pointers.
Reduced motion should be gentler, not removed.

changes: Toast passes the gate as occasional + spatial consistency: enters and exits the same edge via translateY(100%) + opacity, one 400ms transition on cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1) (ease-drawer), percentages not pixels.
Built with a class-toggled CSS transition (not a keyframe) so a toast dismissed mid-entry retargets instead of jumping; 4000ms hold.
The Book button gets the only extra motion: :active scale(0.97) over 160ms ease-out (feedback tier). The slot text swap and the Booked label deliberately stay instant (not worth motion).
Reduced motion becomes a 200ms opacity-only fade (gentler, not zero).
Menu is origin-aware: transform-origin top right (at the trigger), scale(0.95) + opacity, never scale(0).
Speed budget for dropdowns (150-250ms): open 200ms, close 150ms, both on cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); exit is faster than enter.
Items do NOT stagger and the hover/keyboard highlight has no transition: menus are opened tens of times a day, so only the container moves.
Trigger press feedback scale(0.97) at 160ms ease-out; hover styles wrapped in (hover:hover) and (pointer:fine).
Task list is tens-per-day, so motion is kept near-imperceptible: add/remove run 200ms in and 150ms out on cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), with no stagger on the three items.
Rows collapse with grid-template-rows 1fr to 0fr plus opacity (the skill's height+opacity pattern) so the list closes the gap rather than teleporting.
Check-off is feedback only: 120ms fill, 160ms tick draw, 160ms strike-through sweep, checkbox :active scale(0.97).
Count pill and empty-state text swap instantly (functional data the user reads).
